subject: Approval Not Required Plan for 69 Horn Ave
overview: The Community Development Board approved an Approval Not Required plan for 69 Horn Ave and approved its January 13, 2022 meeting minutes. The board also tabled two sets of June 2022 meeting minutes and received staff updates on upcoming development applications and department staffing.

items.title: Approval Not Required Plan: 69 Horn Ave
items.summary: Approved an Approval Not Required plan for 69 Horn Ave to reconfigure three undersized parcels into two buildable lots.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from January 13, 2022, and tabled the minutes from June 9 and June 22, 2022.

items.title: Staff and Project Updates
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on upcoming site plan applications for Tufts University student housing, a Medford Housing Authority project, future development proposals, and new planning staff positions.
